about_the_game:
This pack is inspired by the areas inside Japanese train stations near the “most desirable places to live.”

It’s perfect for creating mystery or adventure games set in train stations or trains.

The pack is composed of Tilesets A4, A5, and B, and includes variations for “daytime,” “evening,” and “nighttime” scenes.
Enjoy creating a variety of scenarios and effects with these flexible pattern options.

The inclusion of time-based variations allows you to express different moods depending on the time of day.

By combining this pack with the “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET”, you can further expand the world of your game. However, this pack can be used on its own even if you don’t own the " SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET "

Contents

  • Tilesets A4, A5, and B (6 sheets in total, including daytime, evening, and nighttime versions)

  • Tile A4: Walls for station interiors, platforms, and inside trains

  • Tile A5: Floor tiles, tactile paving, platform edges, etc.

  • Tile B: Station interiors, ticket gates, escalators, advertisement posters, digital signboards, chairs, fences, columns, and more

All tiles come in daytime, evening, and nighttime variations.

A sample map (project data) is also included.

-------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
